info.name: Project Management System API
info.description:
Productive backend assignment API — full manual test pass.

SETUP: run `rails db:reset && rails db:seed` before running this collection, so IDs match what these requests expect (project 1 = Enterprise Refit / PM Kirk, project 2 = Voyager Refit / PM Scotty).

RUN ORDER MATTERS: folders are ordered top to bottom on purpose (Auth -> Users -> Projects -> Tasks -> Logout). The Logout folder revokes tokens, so it must run last, or later requests using the same token will fail with 401 (which is correct behavior, not a bug).
